newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Latest official statements have mentioned Romania among potential candidates of a first wave admission into NATO, presidency spokesman Traian Chebeleu said.

* He said President Ion Iliescu has sent messages to leaders of the NATO member countries to plead the importance of Romania's admission as full member both for the country and for the Western alliance as a whole.
* Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) is working on completing lists with Romanians entitled to cast their votes in November 3 parliamentary and presidential polls.
* BEC started accrediting foreign observers for the polls. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
